title: Robinhood Chain registry entry (v1)
description: One file under registry/<folder>/<id>.json. Lists public facts about Robinhood Chain infrastructure with their sources. Registry presence is not a Verified Builder, not an endorsement and not HEY verification; a contract listed here does not establish who owns it. Checks this schema cannot express (EIP-55 checksums, unique ids and addresses across the registry, URL normal form, wording) are enforced by the package validator.

id.description: Kebab-case, unique across the registry, equal to the file name without .json.

type.description: Must match the folder: factories, dexes, launchpads, bridges, oracles, explorers, lockers, protocols, infrastructure.

chainId.description: Robinhood Chain only (eip155:4663). Any other value is unsupported_chain.

status.description: Of the infrastructure entry, by its sources.

contracts.description: May be empty only for explorer and infrastructure entries.

address.description: All-lowercase, or EIP-55 checksummed when mixed-case. Unique across the registry.

name.description: The contract's name as its source gives it.

sources.description: Required. https URLs to public evidence: official docs, a deployments file, an explorer verified-source page.

notes.description: Short, factual: how the sources support the entry. No verdicts, endorsements or advice.

addedAt.description: The date the entry was added (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).
